# Copilot Instructions

See [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) (and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) if present) for the full project reference: layout, build/test commands, and conventions. Follow the same rules.

## Review conventions

This repo runs automatic AI reviews on every PR (Claude, plus Copilot and Codex where configured). When reviewing:

- Flag real bugs, security issues, and missing tests — skip style nitpicks the formatter already handles.
- Cross-PR "missing symbol" findings are usually false alarms when branches are stacked; note it, don't duplicate code across PRs.
- Match the conventions of the surrounding code.
